cases.name: Ruth Lucille Loader
cases.about:
She was an 85-pound cancer survivor. 

"Loader had been very poor growing up and had an inferiority complex, despite growing up to be her class valedictorian, and later a valued employee for both General Electric and Timken.

Loader was also “a spitfire,” the family members agreed. “She used to stand in the kitchen with a 22 rifle and ping off the ground hogs,” Henderson said. “She was a good eye,” her son-in-law Tom Gardner said. “She was like Annie Oakley.”

She also took care of people. If a family member needed her, she’d leave the dining room table to bring over food, or hand out food to individuals riding the trains near the old farmhouse.

“She was kind and people appreciated it,” her daughter Bonnie Loader Gardner said."

https://www.timesreporter.com/story/news/2014/08/29/20-years-later-family-haunted/36582642007/
